// Throwaway writer (never committed on the prototype): builds one session with the
// on-demand recipes the prototype 766b20eeb can persist and writes it through its
// REAL save paths — MainWindow::saveLayoutToPath (source-bound and generic) and
// MainWindow::xmlSaveState(kHistory). Output directory: $PJ_FIXTURE_OUT_DIR.

#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include <QApplication>
#include <QDir>
#include <QDomDocument>
#include <QFile>
#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QTemporaryDir>
#include <array>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#include "MainWindow.h"
#include "dataset_test_helpers.h"
#include "pj_base/buffer_anchor.hpp"
#include "pj_base/builtin/builtin_object_codec.hpp"
#include "pj_base/builtin/point_cloud.hpp"
#include "pj_datastore/object_store.hpp"
#include "pj_runtime/AppSession.h"
#include "pj_runtime/CatalogModel.h"
#include "pj_runtime/OnDemandService.h"
#include "pj_runtime/SessionManager.h"
#include "pj_scripting/object_script.h"

using namespace Qt::StringLiterals;

namespace PJ {

// Reuses a MainWindow friend name: this file builds into its own executable.
class MainWindowOnDemandRestoreTestPeer {
 public:
  [[nodiscard]] static AppSession& session(MainWindow& window) {
    return *window.session_;
  }
  static void saveLayout(MainWindow& window, const QString& path, bool include_data_source) {
    window.saveLayoutToPath(path, include_data_source);
  }
  [[nodiscard]] static QDomDocument historySnapshot(const MainWindow& window) {
    return window.xmlSaveState(MainWindow::SnapshotScope::kHistory);
  }
};

}  // namespace PJ

namespace {

using Peer = PJ::MainWindowOnDemandRestoreTestPeer;
using PJ::OnDemandService;
using PJ::sdk::PointCloud;
using PJ::sdk::PointField;

constexpr PJ::Timestamp kSec = 1'000'000'000LL;
constexpr const char* kFakeRoot = "/pj-fixtures";

constexpr const char* kCropScript = R"LUAU(
  local inputs, params = ...
  local cropped = inputs.cloud:crop_box{min={-5,-5,params.zmin}, max={5,5,inputs.threshold}}
  return { cropped = cropped }
)LUAU";

OnDemandService::Recipe cropRecipe(std::string owner, std::string id) {
  OnDemandService::Recipe recipe;
  recipe.owner_plugin = std::move(owner);
  recipe.user_id = std::move(id);
  recipe.language = "luau";
  recipe.script = kCropScript;
  recipe.params_json = R"({"zmin": -5})";
  recipe.inputs = {"cloud", "threshold"};
  recipe.outputs = {PJ::scripting::OutputSpec{
      "cropped", PJ::scripting::OutputType::kObject, PJ::sdk::BuiltinObjectType::kPointCloud}};
  return recipe;
}

PointCloud makeCloud(const std::vector<float>& zs, PJ::Timestamp timestamp_ns) {
  PointCloud cloud;
  cloud.width = static_cast<uint32_t>(zs.size());
  cloud.height = 1;
  cloud.point_step = 16;
  cloud.row_step = cloud.point_step * cloud.width;
  cloud.is_dense = true;
  cloud.frame_id = "base_link";
  cloud.fields = {
      PointField{.name = "x", .offset = 0, .datatype = PointField::Datatype::kFloat32, .count = 1},
      PointField{.name = "y", .offset = 4, .datatype = PointField::Datatype::kFloat32, .count = 1},
      PointField{.name = "z", .offset = 8, .datatype = PointField::Datatype::kFloat32, .count = 1},
      PointField{.name = "intensity", .offset = 12, .datatype = PointField::Datatype::kFloat32, .count = 1},
  };
  cloud.timestamp_ns = timestamp_ns;
  std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(cloud.point_step) * zs.size());
  for (size_t i = 0; i < zs.size(); ++i) {
    const std::array<float, 4> point{0.0f, 0.0f, zs[i], 0.0f};
    std::memcpy(bytes.data() + i * cloud.point_step, point.data(), sizeof(float) * 4);
  }
  PJ::sdk::PayloadView view = PJ::sdk::makePayloadView(std::move(bytes));
  cloud.data = view.bytes;
  cloud.anchor = view.anchor;
  return cloud;
}

QString touch(const QString& path) {
  EXPECT_TRUE(QDir().mkpath(QFileInfo(path).absolutePath()));
  QFile file(path);
  EXPECT_TRUE(file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly));
  return QFileInfo(path).canonicalFilePath();
}

QByteArray relocated(QByteArray bytes, const QString& real_root) {
  bytes.replace(real_root.toUtf8(), QByteArray(kFakeRoot));
  EXPECT_FALSE(bytes.contains(real_root.toUtf8()));
  return bytes;
}

QByteArray readFile(const QString& path) {
  QFile file(path);
  EXPECT_TRUE(file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly));
  return file.readAll();
}

void writeFile(const QString& path, const QByteArray& bytes) {
  QFile file(path);
  ASSERT_TRUE(file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly));
  ASSERT_EQ(file.write(bytes), bytes.size());
}

TEST(PrototypeFixtureWriter, WritesLayouts) {
  const QString out_dir = qEnvironmentVariable("PJ_FIXTURE_OUT_DIR");
  ASSERT_FALSE(out_dir.isEmpty()) << "set PJ_FIXTURE_OUT_DIR";
  ASSERT_TRUE(QDir().mkpath(out_dir));

  QTemporaryDir extensions_dir;
  ASSERT_TRUE(extensions_dir.isValid());
  QTemporaryDir work_dir;
  ASSERT_TRUE(work_dir.isValid());
  const QString path_a = touch(work_dir.filePath(u"pj-fixtures/data/fixture-a.mcap"_s));
  const QString real_root = QFileInfo(work_dir.filePath(u"pj-fixtures"_s)).canonicalFilePath();
  const QString layout_dir = work_dir.filePath(u"layouts"_s);
  ASSERT_TRUE(QDir().mkpath(layout_dir));
  PJ::MainWindow window(extensions_dir.path());
  PJ::AppSession& app = Peer::session(window);
  PJ::SessionManager& session = app.sessionManager();

  // --- one source-bound dataset: a threshold series and a point cloud at 5 s ---
  const PJ::DatasetId dataset = pj_test::createDataset(app, "fixture-a.mcap", /*own_time_domain=*/true);
  ASSERT_NE(dataset, 0U);
  ASSERT_NE(pj_test::addScalarTopic(app, dataset, "threshold", 0, 1), 0U);
  PJ::ObjectStore& store = session.objectStore();
  const auto cloud = store.registerTopic(
      PJ::ObjectTopicDescriptor{
          .dataset_id = dataset, .topic_name = "cloud", .metadata_json = R"({"builtin_object_type":"kPointCloud"})"});
  ASSERT_TRUE(cloud.has_value());
  const auto bytes = PJ::serializeBuiltinObject(PJ::sdk::BuiltinObject(makeCloud({0.5f, 1.5f}, 5 * kSec)));
  ASSERT_TRUE(bytes.has_value());
  ASSERT_TRUE(store.pushOwned(*cloud, 5 * kSec, *bytes).has_value());
  app.catalogModel().rebuildFromDatastore();
  session.setDatasetSourcePath(dataset, path_a);
  session.recordLoadedSource(path_a, QString{}, u"MCAP Loader"_s, u"{}"_s, u"mcap-loader"_s);

  // --- on-demand recipes ---
  OnDemandService& on_demand = session.onDemandService();
  // A chain: crop (labelled) feeds downstream (query_time off).
  auto crop = cropRecipe("fixture-toolbox", "crop");
  crop.label = "Crop box";
  ASSERT_TRUE(on_demand.upsert(crop).has_value());
  auto downstream = cropRecipe("fixture-toolbox", "downstream");
  downstream.inputs = {"fixture-toolbox/crop/cropped"};
  downstream.script = "local inputs = ... return {cropped = inputs['fixture-toolbox/crop/cropped']}";
  downstream.params_json = "{}";
  downstream.query_time = false;
  ASSERT_TRUE(on_demand.upsert(downstream).has_value());
  // A pinned finding.
  auto finding = cropRecipe("fixture-toolbox", "finding");
  finding.pinned_t = 5 * kSec;
  ASSERT_TRUE(on_demand.upsert(finding).has_value());
  // A history-exempt recipe of another plugin.
  auto exempt = cropRecipe("fixture-assistant", "exempt");
  exempt.history_exempt = true;
  ASSERT_TRUE(on_demand.upsert(exempt).has_value());
  // Outputs learned from a trial (infer_outputs="1").
  auto inferred = cropRecipe("fixture-toolbox", "inferred");
  inferred.infer_outputs = true;
  ASSERT_TRUE(on_demand.upsert(inferred).has_value());
  app.catalogModel().rebuildFromDatastore();
  QCoreApplication::processEvents();

  for (const auto& [name, source_bound] : {std::pair{u"source_bound.pj4.xml"_s, true}, {u"generic.pj4.xml"_s, false}}) {
    const QString saved = QDir(layout_dir).filePath(name);
    Peer::saveLayout(window, saved, source_bound);
    writeFile(QDir(out_dir).filePath(name), relocated(readFile(saved), real_root));
  }
  writeFile(
      QDir(out_dir).filePath(u"history_snapshot.xml"_s),
      relocated(Peer::historySnapshot(window).toByteArray(2), real_root));
}

}  // namespace
